name: voicebridge
description: VoiceBridge - business-deployed conversational access layer for high-stakes insurance/financial phone workflows

scripts.brain:lint: cd brain && uv run ruff check .
scripts.agent:smoke: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.agent smoke
scripts.agent:live-check: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.live_readiness
scripts.agent:live-check:strict: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.live_readiness --strict
scripts.agent:dev: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.agent dev
scripts.agent:start: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.agent start
scripts.agent:console: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.agent console
scripts.agent:sip:check: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.transport.sip check
scripts.agent:sip:call: cd agent && uv run python -m voicebridge_agent.transport.sip call
scripts.agent:setup: cd agent && uv sync && uv run --module livekit.agents download-files
